Subject: BrightPath POC Kickstart — alignment, timebox & owners

Hi Alexandra,

Thanks again for the call last week — excited to get the POC kicked off. To make the first session productive, can we lock a 90-minute kickoff in the next two weeks that covers: success criteria, test data access, security alignment, and rollout timeline?

Proposed windows (Pacific):
- Wed Jul 8, 10:00–11:30am
- Thu Jul 9, 1:00–2:30pm
- Mon Jul 13, 9:00–10:30am

Attendees we recommend:
- Alexandra Ruiz (BrightPath) — product/engineering lead
- Marcus Lee (BrightPath) — security/procurement
- Vanessa Ortiz (AE, Redwood) — kickoff owner
- Dylan Brooks (SE, Redwood) — demo & technical owner
- Dev Patel (Customer Success) — onboarding/ops

Attached is a first-pass "POC success checklist" and a simple availability matrix. If you can confirm preferred window and any other invitees (procurement/security rep), I’ll send calendar invites and a short agenda.

Attachment: BrightPath_POC_Success_Checklist.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)
Attachment: BrightPath_Availability_Matrix.csv (CSV, 6KB)

Quick ask: please indicate whether BrightPath requires a separate security questionnaire before the kickoff — if so, can procurement loop in the right contact.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Team — Alex confirmed Thu Jul 9, 1:00–2:30pm PT; Marcus from procurement will join and wants first 15 mins for security gating. Action items before I send invites: 

1) Dylan — bring a concise security slide (SOC2 scope, encryption, data residency + what we need from them). Keep it to 5–7 mins.
2) Dev — own onboarding deliverables & who will manage sample payload ingestion.
3) Lauren — pricing/contract ask: procurement will likely request a slight contract template preview; can you prep a two-slide summary of term options (reserved vs hosted) we can share at a high level?

I attached the checklist + availability matrix — I want owners assigned in the invite. If you see any conflicts, flag here by 3pm PT.

Attachment: BrightPath_POC_Success_Checklist.xlsx
Attachment: BrightPath_Availability_Matrix.csv

Thanks — I’ll send a formal invite once you confirm.

Vanessa
